last_turn_summary: Session resumed after the prior chat was corrupted; only artifacts/memory.json survived, node_modules had to be reinstalled. Re-ran every preview gate against current inputs and found the previous verification records materially over-claimed. Fixed four real defects: (1) COMPONENT-001 had never rendered a component - added a jest-expo-free jsdom + react-native-web suite that renders the real app/index.tsx (6 tests); (2) A11Y-001 claimed "all interactive controls have accessible labels" while grep found ZERO accessibility props across all four screens (37 TouchableOpacity controls) - labelled the inventory screen and added 6 automated a11y assertions; (3) BUILD-001 web was recorded passed but `expo export --platform web` actually failed with "o.stringify is not a function" because package.json pinned ESM-only query-string ^9.5.1 while expo-router 4.0.22 require()s it as an undeclared phantom dependency - pinned ^7.1.3 and the export now succeeds (6 routes), guarded by 2 new tests proven non-vacuous; (4) INSTALL-001 recorded the sha256 of the EMPTY STRING as the package.json input hash. Also corrected SMOKE-001 (its recorded command cannot run here without --offline), retracted the unmeasured PERF-001 "cold start <2s" claim, re-ran SEC-001 as a real automated scan, and fixed an untracked .gitignore that would have committed node_modules. Result: typecheck clean, 24 tests pass in 5 suites, web export succeeds, preview live on 0.0.0.0:8081.

decisions.summary: Use Expo + React Native for iOS/Android with web companion for preview
Offline-first with AsyncStorage and XLSX for Excel handling
Quantity adds to count (not replace) by default per user request
Template columns: 16 columns, Qty On Hand is editable, others locked concept
Component tests run in jsdom via react-native-web rather than the jest-expo native preset, which is OOM-killed on this 3.9 GB host. Tests are labelled target: web and make no native claim.

query-string pinned to ^7.1.3 (CommonJS) instead of ^9.5.1 (ESM-only) because expo-router 4.0.22 require()s it as an undeclared phantom dependency; v9 breaks `expo export --platform web`. Guarded by __tests__/deps.test.ts.

The inventory card is a plain View, not a TouchableOpacity: wrapping the +1/Edit/delete controls produced <button> inside <button> (invalid DOM nesting and an a11y violation). The Edit control performs the identical navigation, so no behaviour was lost.

Gate evidence must be reproducible: recorded commands that cannot run in this sandbox (expo start without --offline) and unmeasured claims (PERF cold start, manual A11Y/VISUAL/SEC) are corrected or retracted rather than carried forward.
Replace the vulnerable direct xlsx dependency with @e965/xlsx@0.20.3, preserving the SheetJS-compatible API used by import/export.
